shoe_reset.impossibleRule: Whenever a foot tries to wear the shoe, the shoe snaps back to its starting position.
shoe_reset.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to put the shoe on; the shoe snaps back while the foot is entering.

brush_growth.impossibleRule: Every completed brush stroke makes the brush larger.
brush_growth.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to brush hair with an already larger brush that grows at the stroke.

eraser_transfer.impossibleRule: Every erased mark appears somewhere else on Noah.
eraser_transfer.frameZeroDescription: Noah tries to erase a mark; the erased mark appears on his face.

wet_towel.impossibleRule: Each wipe leaves the surface wetter.
wet_towel.frameZeroDescription: Noah tries to dry a wet surface; the wipe leaves the surface wetter.

drawer_reversal.impossibleRule: Pulling the drawer outward moves it inward.
drawer_reversal.frameZeroDescription: Noah tries to open the drawer; it slides back inward against the pull.

fork_float.impossibleRule: The fork floats one body height higher whenever lifted.
fork_float.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to eat food while the fork floats above the mouth.

can_adhesion.impossibleRule: The watering can sticks to the cheek whenever lifted.
can_adhesion.frameZeroDescription: Kiko holds a watering can stuck to the cheek.

pencil_adhesion.impossibleRule: The pencil sticks to every body part after each drawing stroke.
pencil_adhesion.frameZeroDescription: Noah draws a line with a pencil stuck to the face.

generic_escape.impossibleRule: The object moves away when touched.
generic_escape.frameZeroDescription: The object moves away from the hand.

soap_slip.impossibleRule: The soap becomes slipperier whenever squeezed.
soap_slip.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to wash hands; the soap becomes slipperier between the palms.

ball_weight.impossibleRule: The ball becomes heavier after every bounce.
ball_weight.frameZeroDescription: Noah tries to bounce the ball and the heavier ball pulls the arm down.

ordinary_fork.impossibleRule: The fork moves normally toward the mouth.
ordinary_fork.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to eat food with a fork.
